source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 350 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 350.

PD 350.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 350 was established by Ordinance No. 20992, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 26, 1991. Ordinance No. 20992 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 20992 was amended by Ordinance No. 21998, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 23, 1994, and Ordinance No. 23009, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 22, 1997. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 20992; 21998; 23009; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 350 is established on property generally fronting on the southwest line of Turtle Creek Boulevard between the south line of Avondale Avenue and the north line of Irving Avenue. The size of PD 350 is approximately 2.937 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20992; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 350A). (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping
Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.106. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are detached single family dwelling units and a guardhouse. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.107. DENSITY.

No more than 16 dwelling units are permitted on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Special Sidewalk Provision
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.108. SPECIAL SIDEWALK PROVISION.

No sidewalk is required along the fire lane access easement shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.109. HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION.

A homeowners’ association for the purpose of proper care and maintenance of the common areas on the Property must be established prior to the issuance of any building permits for single family dwellings on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.110. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts as provided in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.111. SETBACKS.

(a) Except as otherwise provided in Subsections (b) and (c), setbacks must be provided for all structures, including roof overhangs, as indicated by dashed lines on the development plan.

(b) A maximum of four unitary air conditioning units with a standard sound rating number
(SRN) of 18 or less with a minimum separation between each unit of two feet may be located 18 inches from the side property line.

(c) Exterior stairs may extend from the main structure into the rear yard setback as follows:

(1) The stairs may be located no closer than 10 feet from the rear property line.

(2) No portion of the area underneath the stairs may be enclosed.

(3) The uppermost landing of the stairs may not extend more than six feet from the rear building facade.

(4) No portion of the stairs may extend above the second floor. (Ord. Nos. 23009; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.112. HEIGHT.

No residential structure may exceed 44 feet in height, as measured to the ridge or peak of the roof. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Stories
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.113. STORIES.

No residential structure may exceed three stories. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.114. COVERAGE.

(a) Except as further limited by the requirements of Subsection (b), maximum lot coverage for each building site on the Property is 60 percent.

(b) Lot coverage for all lots on the Property combined may not exceed 50 percent. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: West Facade
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.115. WEST FACADE.

No openings (windows, balconies, or doors) are allowed on the west-facing facade above the second floor of structures built on Lots 10 and 11. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Minimum Lot Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.116. MINIMUM LOT SIZE.

Minimum lot size on the Property is 4,500 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.117. PARKING.

Parking must be provided at the ratio of four spaces per residential dwelling unit. Required spaces may be placed in tandem. No parking space may be located between the public right-of-way and a platted building line. All enclosed parking spaces facing upon or accessed directly from a street or alley must be located at least 20 feet from the property line. Excess parking spaces may be provided in the common area easement as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Fences
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.118. FENCES.

The perimeter fence shown on the development plan must be a minimum of six feet in height, and may not exceed eight feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: Guard House
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.119. GUARD HOUSE.

The guardhouse must be located as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21998; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.120. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20992; 21998; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-350.121. ZONING MAP.

PD 350 is located on Zoning Map No. I-7. (Ord Nos. 21998; 25508)
